thesis.business_description: S.C. Macofil S.A. (Târgu Jiu, Romania) manufactures fired-clay construction products (bricks, tiles; CAEN 2332) from local marl and refractory clay and sells through its own distribution network, listed on BVB AeRO since 2015.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional ceramic building-materials producer whose edge is access to local clay deposits and an own distribution network, but demand is tied to Romanian construction cycles and the business is capital- and energy-intensive ([Primet profile](https://primet.ro/actiuni/MACO); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/MACO/company)). Third-party data show about RON 90.7m turnover and 177 employees in 2025, unverified ([termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/2157789)). Dividends of RON 0.50 (2024) and RON 1.00 (2025) per share were paid ([Primet](https://primet.ro/actiuni/MACO)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Concentrated register (7 holders present at the April 2026 AGM represented 75.38% of votes) ([BVB AGOA resolution](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MACO/MACO_20260407145829_Raport-curent-Hotarare-AGOA-07-Aprilie-2026.pdf)); ASF sanctioned the company with a warning over holding-notification publication ([ASF decision](https://asfromania.ro/uploads/articole/attachments/65040913e4728790086297.pdf)); minority shareholders (13 holders, 5.12%) previously pushed for a predictable dividend policy ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/MACO/MACO_20240329133656_Raport-curent-solicitare2-actionari.pdf)); thin AeRO liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Polish group (NewConnect) producing fruit syrups, beverages and dietary supplements, with an additional cannabis/hemp-related subsidiary (Excellence Cannabis, in which it held over 46% with its supervisory board chairman in 2021).
thesis.competitive_position: Polish niche producer of syrups and supplements with annual revenue of about PLN 78.6M in 2024 (about PLN 82.2M TTM mid-2025) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EXC/revenue/)). Limited moat evident: private-label/contract-type manufacturing in a competitive food-supplement market; the founders remain the main holders. Business per [TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/symbols/NEWCONNECT-EXC).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Simply Wall St: Marcin Ciecierski about 31%, Dariusz Polinceusz about 21.4%, Bożena Ciecierska about 0.56% of capital; top-3 holders 52.99% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/food-beverage-tobacco/wse-exc/excellence-shares/ownership)). Parkiet register: Polinceusz with spouse 23.64% of shares / 31.40% of votes; a separate Ciecierski entry 36.63% of votes (date unclear) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/PLEXCLN00016)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting rights and holdings differ across sources and dates (different holder percentages in Simply Wall St vs Parkiet), so the current control picture is unverified. Control sits with two founders (about 52-53% combined), which creates governance-concentration risk; sources show the supervisory board chairman (Ciecierski) is also a top holder and a co-investor in the cannabis subsidiary (related-party dynamics) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/107245,wyniki-finansowe-excellence-za-2021-rok)). NewConnect-listed with 157,730,000 shares; liquidity risk.
thesis.insider_ownership: Marcin Ciecierski (Supervisory Board Chairman since 2013, about 31% per Simply Wall St) and Dariusz Polinceusz (President of the Management Board, about 21.4%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/food-beverage-tobacco/wse-exc/excellence-shares/ownership), [BiznesRadar shareholder letter](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/147922,list-do-akcjonariuszy-grupy-excellence-2025)).

thesis.business_description: Residential property developer founded in 1990 in Alsace (HQ Entzheim, near Strasbourg), building mainly collective housing; about 98.6% of revenue comes from sales of apartments.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional developer focused on Alsace collective housing, with a long local track record but no structural moat and exposure to the French housing cycle and rates ([Euronext activity report 2016](https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/Connect_stradim_rapport_activite_2016.pdf)). Listed on Euronext Growth Paris, ISIN FR0000074775, with 3,439,760 shares and share capital of EUR 12.0M ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/real-estate-management-and-development/epa-alsas/stradim-espace-finances-shares)). A EUR 0.18 dividend was proposed for the 17 June 2026 AGM.
thesis.main_shareholders: Hagenbach family acting in concert (Remi, Jeanne, Clement and Constance Hagenbach) 71.83% of capital and 78% of votes per AMF threshold declaration of Sept 2025, following a donation under a Dutreil pact; Remi Hagenbach alone 41.83% of capital and 45.45% of votes ([AMF filing via FinancialReports](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)). Francis Ebel 8.13%, free float about 20.05% ([Easybourse](https://www.easybourse.com/action-societe/stradim-espace/profil/FR0000074775-25)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by the Hagenbach concert (about 72% of capital, 78% of votes), leaving a free float of roughly 20% and limited liquidity ([AMF filing](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)). Listed on the lighter-regulation Euronext Growth segment. Real-estate development is cyclical and leverage-sensitive; no going-concern, auditor-qualification or litigation wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: Remi Hagenbach (Chairman and CEO) 41.83% of capital / 45.45% of votes; Hagenbach family concert 71.83% / 78% ([AMF filing](https://cdn.financialreports.eu/financialreports/media/filings/1687/2025/RNS/1687_rns_2025-09-22_085b9145-3db9-4853-a7e2-855efaa886aa.pdf)); co-CEO Francis Ebel about 8.13% ([Easybourse](https://www.easybourse.com/action-societe/stradim-espace/profil/FR0000074775-25)).

thesis.business_description: Balticon S.A. (Gdynia, Poland) sells and leases shipping containers and provides storage, repair, road/rail transport and customs services, mainly in Poland, with a Spanish container subsidiary.
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as the leader of the Polish market for container sales and leasing; revenue growth continued in 2025 (Q1 revenue PLN 73.8m, +24% y/y; TTM to Sep-2025 about PLN 311m) ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BLT/); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/commercial-services/wse-blt/balticon-shares/news/balticon-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings)). Moat is scale, inventory and logistics integration rather than a protected niche; results depend on freight-container pricing cycles. A PLN 0.12/share dividend was approved on 1 July 2025.
thesis.main_shareholders: BLT Assets Sp. z o.o. 1,617,012 shares = 52.07%; BLT Biuro Sp. z o.o. 1,339,991 shares = 43.16%; Adrian Kiedrowski 0.28%; Tomasz Szmid (President) 0.10%, per the Q2 2025 report ([Balticon 2Q2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52224958/DOC.20250814.52224958.Raport_kwartalny_skonsolidowany_za_2Q2025-0.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Roughly 95% held by two related-looking entities leaves a free float of about 5% and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics (BLT Assets acquired 51.01% in 2017) ([MarketScreener](https://marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BALTICON-S-A-20706777/news/Blt-Assets-Sp-z-o-o-completed-the-acquisition-of-51-01-stake-in-Balticon-S-A-from-IPON-INVEST-M-35225431)); cyclical container pricing.
thesis.insider_ownership: Tomasz Szmid (management board president) 0.10%; controlling entities BLT Assets and BLT Biuro hold about 95% ([Balticon 2Q2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52224958/DOC.20250814.52224958.Raport_kwartalny_skonsolidowany_za_2Q2025-0.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Internity S.A. (Poland) operates a chain of showrooms selling interior-finishing products (bathroom fittings, ceramic tiles, heating and air-conditioning systems, furniture, appliances) with services for architects and developers, plus an investment-property portfolio.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche premium interior-design retailer with showrooms (new ones in Wrocław, Białystok, Olsztyn) and architect/developer channel relationships; no strong moat and exposed to housing/renovation cycles ([Bonnier-hosted report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf)). 2025 revenue was about PLN 154.0m vs PLN 150m; Q4 2025 EBITDA fell to PLN 3.0m from 8.4m on a high real-estate comparison base ([Bonnier report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf); [Q3 2025 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/52889162/DOC.20251114.52889162.Raport_Kwartalny_Skonsolidowany_Internity_SA_2025_3Q-0.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Earnings partly driven by one-off real-estate revaluations (Q2 2025 profit boosted by an asset revaluation) and cyclical demand; some customers paused orders after drone incident in Poland ([Bonnier Q4 2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260213_165637_0000001121_0000015970.pdf)); thin NewConnect liquidity; current shareholder register not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Notorious Pictures S.p.A. (Italy, Euronext Growth Milan) is an independent film and TV distribution, production and co-production group, with theatrical, home-entertainment and platform licensing activities.
thesis.competitive_position: Independent Italian distributor/producer whose results are lumpy and slate-dependent: consolidated revenue fell 62% to EUR 36.4m in 2025 from EUR 94.8m in 2024, while H1 2026 production value rose 70.7% to EUR 30.0m with a net loss of about EUR 0.8m ([Soldionline](https://www.soldionline.it/?p=154510); [Teleborsa/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/notorious-pictures-valore-della-produzione-balza-a-30-milioni-nel-primo-semestre-159_2026-09-29_TLB.html?lang=it)). Moat is a film library and distribution relationships, offset by high working-capital needs.
thesis.main_shareholders: GUGLY S.r.l. (100% owned by Guglielmo Marchetti) 17,690,480 shares = 78.65%; treasury shares 609,600 = 2.71%; AQA Colombo Extra Return 988,800 shares = 4.40%, of 22,491,480 shares, per the 11 June 2026 disclosure ([Notorious Pictures notice 20047-8-2026](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/20047-8-2026.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Leverage: net financial debt EUR 39.9m at end-2025 rising to EUR 42.3m at 30 June 2026, large versus the very small market cap ([Teleborsa/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/notorious-pictures-valore-della-produzione-balza-a-30-milioni-nel-primo-semestre-159_2026-09-29_TLB.html?lang=it)); 2025 revenue collapse of 62%; controlling holder at about 78.65% with free float around 14%; H1 2026 net loss. Auditor is Deloitte & Touche; no going-concern wording confirmed or found ([Deloitte engagement](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Deloitte-per-Notorious-Pictures-Proposta-revisione-legale-bilancio-esercizio-e-consolidato-triennio-2024-2026.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Guglielmo Marchetti controls 78.65% via GUGLY S.r.l. ([Notorious Pictures notice](https://notoriouspictures.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/20047-8-2026.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Orchard Funding Group plc (UK, AIM) is a specialty lender providing insurance premium finance and related lending to UK customers; it changed its year-end to 31 January 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small UK premium-finance lender; reported record unaudited results for the 12 months to 31 July 2025, with non-Toyota lending of GBP 109.5m vs GBP 101.3m ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/orchard-funding-group--orch/unaudited-results-for-12-months-/9141820); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-group-reports-record-financial-results-for-2025)). Competitive edge is broker relationships and underwriting; the moat is modest and concentrated.
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Rabinder (Ravi) Takhar about 57.2% of voting capital ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/diversified-financials/aim-orch/orchard-funding-group-shares/ownership); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-ceo-boosts-stake-to-over-57)); Jack Boardman 908,539 shares = 4.26% ([Investegate RNS 6 Jun 2025](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/orchard-funding-group--orch/holding-s-in-company/8917193)).
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration: largest customer 'Insure That' entered administration, affecting about GBP 16.7m of the lending book ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-faces-uncertainty-as-major-client-falters)); dividends halted to potentially fund a tender offer ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/orchard-funding-reassesses-capital-strategy-amid-market-challenges)); controlling holder with over 57% and small free float; results were interim/unaudited due to year-end change.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Ravi Takhar about 57.2% of voting capital ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/diversified-financials/aim-orch/orchard-funding-group-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Producer of luminaires and lighting systems, increasingly LED, based in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland; sells industrial, commercial and consumer luminaires mainly in Poland and export markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Established mid-sized Polish luminaire maker with long-running brands such as the MIMO LED range, competing against larger European lighting groups and Asian imports; no structural moat beyond brand, distribution and local manufacturing ([StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LEN/company)). It has paid regular dividends, though a lower dividend was reported ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/109237,nizsza-dywidenda-lena-lighting)), and runs share buybacks ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40987001-lena-lighting-sa-skup-akcji-wlasnych-spolki-lena-lighting-s-a)). The 2024 corporate-governance statement notes no securities carry special control rights.
thesis.main_shareholders: Fundacja Rodzinna Mimo 12,500,000 shares (50.25% of 24,875,050 shares and votes); Nationale-Nederlanden OFE 9.99%; PKO BP Bankowy OFE 7.19% ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/spolka/Lena_Lighting); [corporate governance statement 2024](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-04/Lad-korporacyjny-2024_202504301081260492.xhtml)). A June 2024 shareholding-change notice and correction were filed by the foundation ([ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40747941-lena-lighting-sa-korekta-zawiadomienia-o-zmianie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-spolki)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by a single family foundation holding just over 50% of shares and votes, so minorities have little influence and free float is limited to pension funds and others ([Parkiet](https://parkiet.com/spolka/Lena_Lighting)). The June 2024 ownership notice required a correction, indicating changes in the holding structure ([ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art40747941-lena-lighting-sa-korekta-zawiadomienia-o-zmianie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-spolki)). Cyclical construction/lighting demand and Asian import competition; no going-concern or audit-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Wlodzimierz Lesinski has bought shares on several occasions per MAR notices ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27508921-lena-lighting-nabycie-akcji-emitenta-przez-prezesa-zarzadu)); a historic Parkiet table showed him at 59.21% in 2005. Current personal holding and the link between him and Fundacja Rodzinna Mimo not confirmed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based video game publisher (founded 2019) known for the simulation titles 112 Operator and 911 Operator, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange; recently signed a contract to develop and publish the game Economicon.
thesis.competitive_position: Small publisher of niche simulation games tied to the PlayWay publishing ecosystem (PlayWay is its largest listed holder). Moat is limited to the franchise portfolio and PlayWay distribution relationships; revenue depends on a few titles ([TradingView](https://cn.tradingview.com/chart/GOP/1milROWn/), [Money.pl on Economicon](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7278135980331585.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: PlayWay S.A. 36.39% (2,001,000 shares) per Investing.com (date not shown) ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/games-operators-sa)). Other 5%+ holders not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Dependence on PlayWay as largest holder and ecosystem partner (related-party dynamics); hit-driven revenue from a small number of titles. Supervisory board change recorded 12 Jun 2026 after the 11 Jun 2026 AGM ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7278135980331585.html)). Full 5%+ holder list not verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Zagreb-based milling and food company producing flour (including for 15 private-label brands of Croatian retailers) and related dairy/food lines; about 450 employees and 2024 revenue of about EUR 98.4M.
thesis.competitive_position: Croatian milling and private-label food producer; 2024 revenue about 98.4M (+12.5%) per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/zse/GRNL/); 2023 operating income fell 17% to EUR 54.1M with revenue down about 18%, milling being the only segment to grow ([ZSE 2023 report](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/FI-GRNL-cf667b1b4c71561a6272fb1e26020cf9.pdf)). Commodity-like flour and retailer private-label dependence imply a thin moat and customer concentration.
thesis.main_shareholders: Hrvoje Filipović 58.11% of capital at 31 Dec 2024; ten largest shareholders together 95.77% (2024 management report on the Zagreb Stock Exchange) ([ZSE issuer filings](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/GS-GRNL-a12f19709c374a3f3071634033e97281.pdf)). Q1 2015 report showed Filipović at 60.74% ([ZSE](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/migrated/financials/GRNL-fin2015-1Q-NotREV-K-EN.PDF)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Filipović holds 58.11% and top 10 holders 95.77%, so free float and liquidity are very thin ([ZSE issuer filings](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/GS-GRNL-a12f19709c374a3f3071634033e97281.pdf)). Dependence on Croatian retailers' private-label contracts and volatile grain input costs (2023 revenue fell about 18%) ([ZSE 2023 report](https://eho.zse.hr/fileadmin/issuers/GRNL/FI-GRNL-cf667b1b4c71561a6272fb1e26020cf9.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Hrvoje Filipović, majority shareholder with 58.11% at 31 Dec 2024 (see ZSE filings).

thesis.business_description: Greek provider (HQ Metamorfosi, founded 1992) of furnishing and equipment solutions for retail stores, warehouses and distribution centres, including racking, automation and technology projects, operating mainly in Greece; the group also includes Organizer Stores S.A.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche supplier of retail/warehouse fit-out and storage systems in Greece with a project-based business, so revenue is lumpy; 2025 group revenue fell 8.33% to EUR 38.29M from EUR 41.77M and earnings dropped ~61% to EUR 216k per StockAnalysis data ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/VOSYS/)), with the chairman attributing parent-company 2025 losses to investment in staff and more complex automation projects ([Euro2day](https://www.euro2day.gr/en/article/2356092/nikos-vogiatzoglou-where-will-the-2025-losses-be-a)). 2022 turnover jumped to EUR 24.7M ([Powergame](https://www.powergame.gr/epichirisis/436019/vogiatzoglou-systems-alma-tzirou-sta-247-ekat-to-2022/)). No clear moat beyond local project track record.
thesis.main_shareholders: Nikolaos Vogiatzoglou 82.92% (older ATHEX 2014-15 data) ([ATHEX](https://www.athexgroup.gr/el/documents/10180/2497143/%CE%92%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%99%CE%91%CE%A4%CE%96%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A5%20SYSTEMS%20%CE%91.%CE%95.%20%282015%29/66cfa5d2-5d23-472b-8f5e-17ae0c42d607)); Simply Wall St shows individual insiders ~83% and public ~15.5% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/capital-goods/ath-vosys/vogiatzoglou-systems-shares/ownership)).
thesis.red_flags: Parent-company losses in 2025 and sharply lower earnings (EUR 216k, -61%) on revenue down 8.3% ([Euro2day](https://www.euro2day.gr/en/article/2356092/nikos-vogiatzoglou-where-will-the-2025-losses-be-a), [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/VOSYS/)). Very high insider concentration (~83%) leaves ~15.5% free float and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics. Project-based revenue and customer concentration not quantified in sources found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-chairman Nikolaos Vogiatzoglou holds ~82.9% (ATHEX 2014-15 data; Simply Wall St ~83% insiders) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gr/capital-goods/ath-vosys/vogiatzoglou-systems-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Pirmasens (Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany) brewer producing beer brands including Park, Bellheimer, Valentins Weissbier and Rheingoenheimer, plus alcohol-free beverages; founded 1888.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional German brewer and beverage producer with consolidated revenue of about EUR 24.77M (audit report filed 2025-07-25, per [FinancialReports](https://financialfilings.com/companies/park-bellheimer-ag/)). No evidence found of pricing power or a durable moat; the German beer market is mature and fragmented, and the company's scale is small (5,000,000 shares; market cap about EUR 10-12.5M per [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/food-beverage-tobacco/fra-pkb/park-bellheimer-shares/information) and [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/de:pkb)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based brokerage house (NWAI Dom Maklerski S.A.) offering brokerage, issuer services (IPO/offer, issue sponsor) and investment services, with a focus on Polish small caps; transferred from NewConnect to the GPW Main Market, first main-market trading day 29 July 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche broker in the Polish market; its net profit in 2025 was PLN 8.8M ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-gpw-2026)). It acted as issue sponsor for Quercus fund certificates until April 2026, when KDPW records show it ceased that role for one fund ([KDPW](https://www.kdpw.pl/uploads/documents/resolutions/2026/0367-2026.pdf)). Revenue is market-cycle dependent and the firm is tiny against XTB, mBank, PKO BP DM; no scale moat. The main-market move was done without a public offer ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-na-gpw)).
thesis.main_shareholders: New World Holding SA (parent; percentage not retrieved) per company profile data ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/NWA)); full structure is in the 2025 annual report ([NWAI report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1595_20260317_200300_Raport_roczny_NWAI_2025_2_WD.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Parent-controlled (subsidiary of New World Holding SA), so controlling-holder dynamics apply; small free float. Earnings are cyclical with equity-market turnover and small-cap IPO activity. Share price jumped ~7% on first main-market day to PLN 35.6 and rose >140% in ~six months per press ([Comparic](https://comparic.pl/akcje-brokera-z-gpw-rosna-o-20-w-kilka-dni-i-ponad-140-w-pol-roku-czy-xtb-wyrasta-nowy-konkurent/)), implying momentum-driven valuation risk. Share-count figures differ across sources (1,746,583 vs 1,786,723 shares).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (CEO Mateusz Walczak and board member Magdalena Graca; holdings not retrieved) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/debiut-ipo/nwai-debiut-gpw-2026)).

thesis.business_description: Kościan-based Polish children's clothing group owning the Coccodrillo, Lemon Explore, Petit Bijou and Broel brands plus Fikołki Playrooms, selling through its own store network in Poland and abroad; a 2021 report also lists the Buslik children's supermarket chain in Belarus.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Polish children's-apparel brand owner with vertically integrated own-brand retail; trailing-twelve-month revenue about PLN 266.9M but net profit only about PLN 2.9M (down 93.5%) per a Feb 2026 snapshot ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/CDL/)). Brand recognition is the main asset; margins are exposed to fashion, cost inflation and competition from discount and large-chain retailers (no evidence of a hard moat). Brand portfolio per [Strefa Inwestorow IPO analysis](https://strefainwestorow.pl/artykuly/debiut-ipo/analiza-ipo-czy-warto-kupic-akcje-coccodrillo-czyli-spolki-cdrl-sa).
thesis.main_shareholders: Forsmart Ltd 41.68%, Tomasz Przybyła 21.66%, Marek Dworczak 20.97% (Stockwatch, data to 1 Oct 2026; Przybyła/Dworczak updates Aug 2026) ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/cdrl,akcjonariat,kapitalizacja.aspx)); NN OFE about 6% per BiznesRadar ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/akcjonariat/CDL)). thesis.business_description: London-based software provider of products and services for real-time financial market data processing and trading, selling to banks and financial institutions; fiscal year ends 30 June. FY2025 turnover was GBP 3.11M.
thesis.competitive_position: Micro-cap niche vendor in market-data software, small against Bloomberg/LSEG/FactSet-style incumbents; it relies on a small number of sticky institutional users and consulting work. FY to 30 June 2025: turnover GBP 3,106,991 (+6.8%), profit before tax GBP 987,390 (about -10%), EPS 7.05p, dividend 4.00p (2024: 3.75p); growth credited to a new high-end customer and the return of consulting revenue ([Final Results RNS](https://www.ticker.app/lse/ARC/rns/2025-09-10/Final-Results-for-the-year-ended-30-June-2025/6834Y), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/arcontech-reports-revenue-growth-and-dividend-increase-amidst-competitive-market)). Switching costs for embedded users are a mild moat, but costs rose (staffing) and H1 FY26 revenue fell 4.7% to GBP 1,439,382 ([Investegate](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/arcontech-group--arc/interim-results-for-the-six-months-ended-31-dec-25/9410041)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Williams de Broe Ltd 15.94% of voting rights via Pershing Nominees per an RNS holdings notice (undated, may be stale) ([LSE RNS](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/ARC/holdings-in-company-ns4sqrtlu3cewim.html)); Simply Wall St lists only small holders (IG Group 0.32%, Rathbones 0.29%, Peel Hunt 0.27%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-arc/arcontech-group-shares/ownership)). Holding notices were filed 26 Feb 2025 and 5 Feb 2026 (contents not retrieved).
thesis.red_flags: Revenue decline in H1 FY26 (-4.7%) and falling FY25 profit amid a challenging market ([Alliance News via LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/arcontech-profit-falls-despite-revenue-rise-amid-challenging-market-p5ov5xjde7sy9r2.html)). Small scale, probable customer concentration (growth tied to one new high-end customer; concentration not quantified in sources found), AIM illiquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed (director PDMR shareholding notices published 5-6 Feb 2026; holdings not retrieved) ([ticker.app](https://www.ticker.app/lse/ARC/rns/2026-02-05/DirectorPDMR-Shareholding/9576R)).

thesis.business_description: Koensk-based (Swietokrzyskie) producer, seller, renter and assembler of its own construction/industrial products (former Betomax Polska, renamed Jan 2025) for construction, industrial and infrastructure customers in Poland; group includes 100% subsidiary Pamexpol Sp. z o.o.
thesis.competitive_position: Regional niche manufacturer of concrete/construction products and related rental and assembly services, with no evident wide moat; 2024 revenue was PLN 88.6M for the company and PLN 103.5M for the group ([2024 management report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51660304/DOC.20250527.51660304.5._Sprawozdanie_z_dzialalnosci_i_GK_za_2024-6.pdf)). Q1 2025 revenue was PLN 26.6M (+11% y/y) with net profit PLN 1.38M (-13%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-frb/forbuild-shares/news/forbuild-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings)). Dependence on Polish construction cycle; management called 2025 a difficult year given the war in Ukraine.
thesis.main_shareholders: As of 27 Jan 2025: Maciej Pasturczak (with concert parties incl. Katarzyna Luczynska) 2,467,190 shares (20.55% of capital, 20.41% of votes); Piotr Pieta 17.64% of capital and 18.24% of votes; FRAM Fundacja Rodzinna 1,070,849 shares (8.92% of capital, 6.65% of votes) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/FORBUILD/akcjonariat)). Later change-of-vote notices exist (Aug and Sep 2025) but contents were not retrieved ([Money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/?isin=plbetmx00013)).
thesis.red_flags: Fragmented control with several blocks and family foundations; voting preference shares make votes differ from capital (FRAM 8.92% capital vs 6.65% votes) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/FORBUILD/akcjonariat)). Share capital reduced from PLN 1.34M to PLN 1.20M (Series D shares cancelled, Jan 2025) ([2024 report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51660304/DOC.20250527.51660304.5._Sprawozdanie_z_dzialalnosci_i_GK_za_2024-6.pdf)). Small-cap liquidity risk. No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
