thesis.business_description: Korbank S.A. (Wrocław, Poland) is a telecommunications operator providing data/telecom services to companies, institutions and housing estates in Poland and abroad, with a B2C customer-acquisition subsidiary (Korbank-Media Cyfrowe).
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional fibre/telecom operator competing with large incumbents; edge lies in local network assets and B2B contracts, with no national scale moat. Q3 2025 revenue was PLN 11.06m (+7.5%); trailing revenue was about PLN 41.7m with net income about PLN 5.1m (June 2025 snapshot) ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/KOR/revenue/); [Korbank Q4 2025 report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-02/20260216_230708_0000001274_0000064397.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Tymoteusz Biłyk 3,994,894 shares = 80.92% of capital and 88.13% of votes (as of 2012); Paweł Paluchowski 210,000 shares = 4.46% ([Parkiet - Korbank](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235941-korbank)); Simply Wall St shows CEO ownership at 81.8% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/telecom/wse-kor/korbank-shares/management)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling shareholder holds about 81% of capital and 88% of votes, leaving a tiny free float and thin liquidity; controlling-holder dynamics (potential squeeze-out/delisting risk, none announced); register data dated 2012 for percentage detail.
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman/CEO Tymoteusz Biłyk about 81% of capital (80.92% in 2012 filing; 81.8% per Simply Wall St) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235941-korbank); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/telecom/wse-kor/korbank-shares/management)).

thesis.business_description: Polish asset-management group (Caspar Asset Management S.A.) running Caspar TFI, which manages the Caspar Parasolowy FIO umbrella fund and nine closed-end funds, plus individual portfolios; Poland only. Net AUM across the sub-funds and closed-end funds was about PLN 1.59bn at end-April 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Small, boutique Polish fund manager: net AUM of PLN 244.5M in 5 Parasolowy FIO sub-funds and PLN 1,342.4M in 9 closed-end funds at end-April 2026, up from PLN 195.2M and PLN 1,239.2M at end-2025 ([Bankier ESPI](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/CASPAR-ASSET-MANAGEMENT,3), [Bankier ESPI Jan 2026](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art37355291-caspar-am-sa-wartosc-aktywow-pod-zarzadzaniem-caspar-asset-management-s-a)). Mostly closed-end funds for dedicated investors give sticky but concentrated AUM; no scale or brand moat versus large Polish TFIs. Management plans to simplify into a listed holding with asset management moved into Caspar TFI during 2026 ([Analizy.pl](https://www.analizy.pl/tylko-u-nas/40250/caspar-uklada-grupe-na-nowo-bez-alfy-aktywne-fundusze-nie-maja-po-co-istniec)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Przedwojski 28.58%, Leszek Kasperski 28.39%, Blazej Bogdziewicz 27.49% of votes at the GM, others 15.54% (Q1 2024 report) ([ESPI report](https://money2.wpcdn.pl/gielda/gpw/espi/129/6940801510307457_4.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Management turnover: president Hanna Kijanowska resigned effective 30 Sep 2025 ([Analizy.pl](https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/40125/caspar-am-uzupelnia-zarzad-piotr-przedwojski-ma-objac-funkcje-prezesa)). Three founders hold ~84% of votes, leaving ~15.5% free float and thin liquidity. Revenue depends on AUM-based fees and a few closed-end funds, with business-model restructuring underway (TFI reorganisation in 2026).
thesis.insider_ownership: Three insiders hold ~84.5% combined: Przedwojski 28.58%, Kasperski 28.39%, Bogdziewicz 27.49% (Q1 2024) ([ESPI report](https://money2.wpcdn.pl/gielda/gpw/espi/129/6940801510307457_4.pdf)).

name: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A.

thesis.business_description: Katowice-based manufacturer of mining chains and related equipment (FASING group); chains are sold for mining, but also fishing, energy, sugar, cement and timber industries, with Polish coal mining as the core customer base.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established niche producer of round-link chains for underground mining, a captive-market niche tied to Polish hard-coal producers; the company describes its activity as production of chains for mining, fishing, energy, sugar, cement and wood industries ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)). Moat is installed relationships and certification in a small specialised market, but demand is exposed to the structural decline of Polish coal mining. Equity of ~USD 47M against market cap of ~USD 13M (per input data) suggests the market prices in weak returns on the asset base. Annual reports are published on the company site ([FASING 2023 report](https://www.fasing.pl/files/raporty_okresowe/19/consolidated_annual_report_of_2023.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Karbon 2 Sp. z o.o. and Anna Bik are the controlling holders: in August 2025 they announced a tender for 1,232,231 shares at PLN 12.50 ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)), after Karbon 2 had earlier tendered for the 'remaining 38.22%' in 2021 at PLN 12.46 ([MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FABRYKI-SPRZETU-I-NARZEDZ-11193955/news/Karbon-2-Sp-z-o-o-launched-a-tender-offer-to-acquire-remaining-38-22-stake-in-Fabryki-Sprzetu-i-N-36098858)); exact current percentages not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Karbon 2 / Anna Bik have repeatedly bid for the minority (2021 and 2025 tenders), pointing to possible further squeeze-out or delisting risk and a ceiling-like bid price (PLN 12.50) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)). Only 74,937 shares were reportedly acquired on 6 Oct 2025, i.e. minority holders largely declined ([Bossa filing](https://bossa.pl/sites/b30/files/2025-10/document/Informacja%20o%20liczbie%20akcji%20b%C4%99d%C4%85cych%20przedmiotem%20nabycia_FSG.pdf)). Thin free float (3,107,249 shares in issue per 2020 report) and end-market tied to declining Polish coal mining.
thesis.insider_ownership: Anna Bik (with Karbon 2 Sp. z o.o.) controls a majority of the shares; exact % not retrieved ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/FASING,3)).

thesis.business_description: Malta-based IT company (formerly Datatrak IT Services) providing software development, application service provision and web-based services, with growth driven by its openFleet delivery-management platform; FY to 30 June 2025 revenue about EUR 12.87M.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Maltese software/IT services provider; FY2025 revenue growth of about 9% was driven by openFleet, and the company returned to a small profit (about EUR 118k vs a EUR 625k loss in 2023/24, per [Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/strict-discipline-drives-loqus-return-to-profitability); another source shows EUR 130k) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/mse/LQS/revenue)). Limited moat: niche product exposure in a small domestic market.
thesis.main_shareholders: JFC Holdings Limited about 66.92% after buying a further about 6.74% in June 2026 (Company Announcement 249/2026, 10 Jun 2026) ([Malta Stock Exchange](https://cdn.borzamalta.com.mt/download/announcements/LQS249.pdf)). Earlier: JFC held 50%, then 59.4% after its 2025 voluntary takeover bid ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/jfc-holdings-becomes-majority-owner-of-loqus-holdings-with-59-4-stake)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder JFC Holdings (about 66.92%) is progressively increasing its stake and has said it may propose delisting from the Malta Stock Exchange Alternative Companies List (delisting/low-free-float risk) ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/jfc-holdings-becomes-majority-owner-of-loqus-holdings-with-59-4-stake)). Trading was suspended at the company's request around the bid (Aug 2025), and MFSA suspended trading in the shares in 2012 ([MaltaToday](https://maltatoday.com.mt/business/business_news/19648/mfsa-suspends-trading-in-shares-of-loqus-plc-20120716)). Thin profitability after prior losses.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder JFC Holdings Limited; a Who's Who Malta headline links the stake increase to Joe Fenech Conti ([Who's Who Malta](https://whoswho.mt/en/joe-fenech-conti-set-to-increase-stake-in-loqus-to-75-shareholding)). Individual director holdings not retrieved.

thesis.business_description: MakoLab S.A. (Łódź, Poland) is an IT services and software house (PKD 6201) delivering digital commerce, consulting and custom software to clients mainly in Poland and Europe, through subsidiaries such as MakoLab Consulting.
thesis.competitive_position: Small Polish IT services provider with a long track record (founded 1989 by Mirosław Sopek), with growth in 2025 coming from electrical and drugstore-sector clients ([ITWiz](https://itwiz.pl/makolab-zakonczyl-2025-rok-z-779-mln-zl-skonsolidowanych-przychodow-ze-sprzedazy/)). 2025 group revenue was PLN 77.9m (+4%), operating profit PLN 6.41m and net profit PLN 4.13m ([MakoLab reports for 2025](https://makolab.com/insights/MakoLab-reports-for-2025)). No structural moat beyond client relationships; competes in a commoditised IT-services market.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Mirosław Sopek is a named shareholder; large holders together reported at 53.57% of votes on about 6.99m shares, but the individual breakdown is dated 2016-17 ([Bankier shareholders page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MAKOLAB/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Key-person/leadership disruption: long-time CEO Wojciech Zieliński died at end-2025 and Mirosław Sopek is acting President ([ITWiz](https://itwiz.pl/makolab-zakonczyl-2025-rok-z-779-mln-zl-skonsolidowanych-przychodow-ze-sprzedazy/)); controlling-holder concentration and thin NewConnect liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Mirosław Sopek is a shareholder and supervisory board member/acting CEO; exact stake not verified ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MAKOLAB/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: Krakow-based developer of logistics and manufacturing software (Qguar WMS Pro, TMS, TMS Mobile, MES, APS, YMS), selling licences, implementation, training and support mainly to Polish companies.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Polish vendor of warehouse and transport management systems competing against international suites and local integrators; recurring support and implementation work gives some stickiness but no network-effect moat. Revenue was PLN 53.69M in 2024 (+5.07%) per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/QNT/)); Craft.co lists ~PLN 56.8M for 2025, unverified ([Craft](https://craft.co/quantum-software-s-a)). Products include Qguar WMS Pro and Qguar TMS ([Value at Risk](https://valueatrisk.substack.com/p/wsparcie-procesow-logistycznych-i)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Quantum Assets sp. z o.o.: 675,421 registered series A shares (privileged voting) = 49.49% of capital plus 295,491 bearer shares = 21.65% of capital (13.97% of votes), per Q1 2026 report as cited by Parkiet ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)); Tomasz Hatala ~4.62% (2022 Stockwatch data) ([Stockwatch](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/QUANTUM,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx)).
thesis.red_flags: Possible delisting / takeover: Parkiet reports Quantum Software 'may disappear from the exchange' and that the lead shareholder does not rule out a majority investor or selling its stake; a tender for up to ~73 thousand shares at PLN 38 ran 27 Aug - 24 Sep ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)). Controlling-holder dynamics: Quantum Assets holds ~71% of capital with privileged registered shares, leaving minorities little influence. Limited free float and liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Tomasz Hatala is the main shareholder directly and via Quantum Assets; board members Ozog, Jedra, Mnich are also significant holders (older undated source) ([Value at Risk](https://valueatrisk.substack.com/p/wsparcie-procesow-logistycznych-i)); Quantum Assets holds ~71.1% of capital ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45124001-quantum-software-moze-zniknac-z-gieldy-jakie-sa-scenariusze)).

thesis.business_description: Greek distributor of diagnostic instruments, reagents and laboratory/clinical-research equipment (Medicon Hellas S.A., HQ Gerakas, Attica), serving hospitals and clinical and research labs in Greece. Revenue about EUR 18M.
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as a market leader in Greek diagnostics, supplying instruments, tests and procedures to clinical and research laboratories ([Medicon company profile](https://mediconsa.com/en/company-profile)). It is a distributor, so its position rests on supplier agreements and service relationships rather than proprietary technology; no strong moat evident. 2024 revenue was ~EUR 18.1M with net income ~EUR 1.37M and about 4.42M shares ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ath/MEDIC/)); 2025 interim sales were EUR 17.954M vs EUR 18.375M, a decline ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/medicon-hellas-sa/interim-quarterly-report/2026/39117566/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Revenue softening (EUR 17.95M vs EUR 18.38M) ([financialreports.eu](https://financialreports.eu/filings/medicon-hellas-sa/interim-quarterly-report/2026/39117566/)). Concentrated ownership: AGM of 30 June 2026 had 66.5% of capital voting, consistent with a controlling block and limited free float ([Euronext Athens filing](https://athens.euronext.com/sites/default/files/hermes_3/2026-06/el/c6bb3c28-2298-42f2-bb3c-28229872f22d/873_4854_2026_Greek_1.pdf)). Dependence on public-hospital customers and Greek payment cycles not verified in sources found. Thin liquidity (market cap ~EUR 10-12M).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: French company (HQ Corbas, near Lyon) distributing vaping products (e-liquids, devices) in France, listed on Euronext Growth Paris since June 2021; describes itself as a reference player in vaping product distribution.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the French vaping distributors, positioned as a reference player in the segment in a shrinking, heavily regulated market; 2025 revenue was EUR 57.5M (-5.2% vs EUR 60.7M), net profit EUR 1.0M, EBITDA down 38% to EUR 2.5M (4.4% of sales) ([Kumulus Vape results](https://groupe.kumulusvape.fr/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/CP-Resultats-2025_vDef.pdf), [Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/kumulus-vape-ca-2025-a-57-4-m-eur-kumulus-vape-resiste-dans-un-contexte-de-forte-adversite-et-prepare-son-rebond-d16f3374e1017737e8d183ef65c0c71d)). Gross financial debt EUR 3.5M vs cash EUR 5.2M at 31 Dec 2025. Brand and distribution network are the only moat; no pricing power evident.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Remi Baert (CEO), Astrid Menut and Rokh Vision were the main selling shareholders at the 2021 IPO ([Euronext](https://www.euronext.com/fr/about/media/euronext-press-releases/kumulus-vape-sintroduit-en-bourse-sur-euronext-growth-paris)); current percentages not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Regulatory risk for vaping in France (the company cites persistent regulatory uncertainty and weak consumption) ([Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/kumulus-vape-ca-2025-a-57-4-m-eur-kumulus-vape-resiste-dans-un-contexte-de-forte-adversite-et-prepare-son-rebond-d16f3374e1017737e8d183ef65c0c71d)); falling profitability (net profit down from EUR 2.6M in 2024 to EUR 1.0M; dividend cut to EUR 0.10) ([BourseDirect](https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/resultats/kumulus-vape-le-benefice-tombe-a-1-me-en-2025-dividende-ramene-a-0-10e-boursier-76a4c23d9ee6b383de384134305664b760b309ac)); founder-led governance; a September 2025 off-market block buyback of 289,631 shares from a historic shareholder at EUR 3.6271 (EUR 1.05M) ([Kumulus Vape](https://groupe.kumulusvape.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Copie-de-Rachat-bloc.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and CEO Remi Baert is a main shareholder; exact % not retrieved ([Euronext](https://www.euronext.com/fr/about/media/euronext-press-releases/kumulus-vape-sintroduit-en-bourse-sur-euronext-growth-paris)).

thesis.business_description: Biogened S.A. (Łódź, Poland) is a pharmaceutical and dermocosmetics company selling prescription and OTC medicines, dietary supplements and pharmacy-channel dermocosmetics (Dermedic brand), mainly in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish pharmacy-channel player in a crowded generics/dermocosmetics market; differentiation rests on the Dermedic brand and partly patent-protected formulas, with no evident structural moat ([Stockanalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BGD/company); [Biogened profile at Gemini.pl](https://gemini.pl/producent/biogened)). Reported 2024 revenue was about PLN 110.9m, up about 16% ([Stockanalysis revenue](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/BGD/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Bioniq Limited 400,000 shares = 16.28% of 2,456,319 shares, with other named holders 144,714 shares = 5.89%, per the Q4 2025 quarterly report ([Biogened Q4 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1185_20260216_124600_Raport-Kwartalny-za-4Q2025.pdf)); full list not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Very small free float (reported 5.89%) and concentrated register imply thin liquidity; market-listing venue is reported inconsistently (WSE main vs NewConnect) across data vendors ([Bankier shareholders page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/BIOGENED/akcjonariat)). Share count/market cap in the input appears inconsistent with the reported 2,456,319 shares and should be verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Birmingham, UK manufacturer and distributor of luxury bathroom fittings and architectural ironmongery, selling to UK and international (including US) customers from a single UK facility; AIM-listed.
thesis.competitive_position: Closely held luxury-niche manufacturer with a premium brand and UK production but small scale (revenue about GBP 14.8M) and exposed to UK property-market and US tariff conditions ([Samuel Heath annual report FY2025](https://www.samuel-heath.com/app/uploads/sites/3/2025/09/Annual_Report_and_Accounts_Yr_ended_31-03-25.pdf); [Demystified Value](https://demystifiedvalue.substack.com/p/samuel-heath-and-sons-plc-hsm-a-nano)). FY to 31 Mar 2026 revenue was flat at GBP 14.826M (GBP 14.769M FY2025), with US tariffs passed on to customers and a tougher second half; the full-year dividend was held at 13.0625p ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/heath-samuel-sons--hsm/final-results-notice-of-agm-dividend/9689942)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the company's AIM Rule 26 page (Feb 2025): Samuel Heath Discretionary Will Trust about 18% (455,800 shares); C A Heath 14.94% (378,710 shares); G S Heath 14.94% (378,710 shares); earlier version also listed VOB&T UK Limited 12.21% and S A Perkins (nee Heath) 10.76% ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)).
thesis.red_flags: Family-concentrated register (Heath family trust and individuals hold well over half) with limited free float and liquidity ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)). Profitability volatile: a tougher second half in FY2026 with RNS profit for the year of GBP 204k versus GBP 888k, while a press report cites a higher pre-tax figure, so the numbers conflict ([Investegate RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/heath-samuel-sons--hsm/final-results-notice-of-agm-dividend/9689942)). Exposure to US tariffs and UK taxation changes affecting international clients. Single-site operations.
thesis.insider_ownership: Heath family holdings through the Samuel Heath Discretionary Will Trust (about 18%) and individuals C A Heath and G S Heath (14.94% each); A R Buttanshaw (chair) is a trustee of the trust ([Samuel Heath investor relations](https://samuel-heath.com/investor-relations/director-and-significant-shareholdings)).

name: Société Française de Casinos Société Anonyme

thesis.business_description: Romanian manufacturer (Targu Mures / Sangeorgiu de Mures) of induction heating equipment for surface hardening, forging pre-heating, melting and dedicated heating solutions; sells mainly to export markets (Germany, France, Hungary, Tunisia, Scandinavia, Mexico, others).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche industrial engineering manufacturer of induction heating systems, founded by engineers from ICPE Bucharest's Targu Mures branch and listed on BVB since June 2017 ([Transylvania Now](https://transylvanianow.com/designed-and-built-in-transylvania-used-by-factories-worldwide/)). Competes against larger European induction-heating specialists (e.g. EMA Indutec, Rayteq per CB Insights peer lists) ([CB Insights](https://www.cbinsights.com/company/aages-targu-mures/alternatives-competitors)); moat is engineering know-how and customised systems rather than scale. FY2024 revenue was RON 58.5M (+27%) per Simply Wall St, while trailing figures later show revenue ~RON 43.5M and net income down ~71% ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/AAG/), [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/capital-goods/bvb-aag/sc-aages-shares/news/sc-aages-full-year-2024-earnings-eps-ron113-vs-ron067-in-fy)).
thesis.main_shareholders: AAGES Head Invest SRL (controlled by Gabor Molnar) ~55% ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/aages-targu-mures-plus-6-5-joi-pe-fondul-unui-profit-de-3-2-mil-lei-20246337)); Gabor Jozsef Molnar directly ~10.55% and Sytec Finance GmbH ~5%, RCC Consult ~4% (older IPO-era breakdown, may be outdated) ([Profit.ro](https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/financiar/piata-de-capital/exclusiv-aages-intra-astazi-la-tranzactionare-cum-arata-emitentul-si-ce-planuri-are-actionarul-majoritar-17041332)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by a majority holder (~55% via Head Invest) so minority holders have limited influence. Earnings volatility: trailing net income down ~71% YoY per StockAnalysis ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bvb/AAG/)). Cyclical, export-dependent industrial demand; no data found on customer concentration. Thinly traded BVB micro-cap.
thesis.insider_ownership: Gabor Molnar controls ~55% through AAGES Head Invest SRL plus ~10.55% directly (older breakdown) ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/aages-targu-mures-plus-6-5-joi-pe-fondul-unui-profit-de-3-2-mil-lei-20246337)); 2026 AGM report notes Molnar and Doki Janos Tibor abstaining on 971,822 shares (9.72%) ([BVB](https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/AAG_20260527142948_Raportul-curent-pentru-Hot-AGA-din-27-05-2026.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Bialystok-based industrial automation, electrical engineering and robotics contractor founded in 1993, serving energy, chemical and industrial customers; owns 100% of ELREM Sp. z o.o. (acquired 2015).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional industrial-automation integrator with references such as Grupa Azoty, PGE, Enea and Energa, so project-based revenue is tied to large Polish energy and chemical clients rather than a durable moat ([EMIS / sector profile](https://emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/APS_SA_en_2432228.html); [Automatyka Online](https://automatykaonline.pl/en/Articles/Services/20-lat-innowacji-firmy-APS)). It was one of the first Podlasie companies to debut on NewConnect. It has been recognised for innovation in the sector ([Automatyka Online](https://automatykaonline.pl/switchlanguage/to/en/Z-branzy/APS-laureatka-Innowacji-2014)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Historic Parkiet table (undated, 5,296,839 shares and 8,696,251 votes): Boguslaw Lacki about 23.24% of votes; Jerzy Buslowski and Marcin Proskien about 12.17% of votes each; Jaroslaw Skorulski about 7.96%; Piotr Krukowski about 6.40%; a more recent snapshot shows Buslowski with 540,116 shares (10.19% of capital) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)). Official 5% lists for the AGMs of 28 Jun 2024 and 27 Jun 2025 exist but were not readable ([FinancialReports](https://financialreports.eu/companies/automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie-spolka-akcyjna/)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting preference: 8.70M votes vs 5.30M shares, so founders/insiders control more votes than capital ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)). Project-based revenue with exposure to large state-linked energy/chemical customers. NewConnect-listed micro-cap with thin liquidity. Ownership data is partly dated. No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/management-linked holders listed in Parkiet table (e.g. Jerzy Buslowski, Boguslaw Lacki, Marcin Proskien) hold roughly 12-23% of votes each, undated; exact roles not confirmed in sources found ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/230121-automatyka-pomiary-sterowanie)).

name: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego Spólka Akcyjna

thesis.business_description: Norwegian regional savings bank (Hoeland og Setskog Sparebank, trading as HS Bank) whose equity certificates are listed on Euronext Oslo Bors (HSPG); lending is mainly residential mortgages and housing construction, with gross loans of NOK 7.5bn in Q3 2024.
thesis.competitive_position: Small local savings bank with a community franchise but no scale advantage versus large Norwegian banks; CET1 was 16.7% in Q3 2024 (16.6% a year earlier) ([Q3 2024 report](https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/company_press_releases/attachments_oslo/2024/10/31/630854_2024%20Q3%20Kvartalsrapport%20med%20revisjonsberetning.pdf)) and 18.56% at end-2023. Pre-provision result was NOK 18.7M in Q1 2025 vs NOK 20.1M a year earlier ([Q1 2025 report](https://www.hsbank.no/-/media/banker/hsbank/dokumenter/regnskap/2025-Q1-Kvartalsrapport.pdf)). Market cap was about NOK 117M ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/no/banks/ob-hspg/hland-og-setskog-sparebank-shares/ownership)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: The Finanstilsynet supervisory report (June 2024, based on a 2023 inspection) said the bank has had high non-performing loans and large loan losses over time ([Finanstilsynet](https://www.finanstilsynet.no/49ebb3/contentassets/69fee16587794c0b9eb9a5f461612931/tilsynsrapport-holand-og-setskog-sparebank.pdf)). Concentrated exposure to housing and construction lending. As a savings bank, equity certificate holders hold only part of total equity (the rest is primary capital/ownerless), limiting shareholder claims; tiny equity-certificate market cap implies low liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: Administrative director John Sigurd Bjoerknes bought certificates in March 2026 and now holds 2,320 equity certificates ([MFN](https://www.mfn.se/ob/a/holand-og-setskog-sparebank/hspg-meldepliktig-handel-497c2a31)).

thesis.business_description: Katowice-based Polish contractor providing installation services in the power industry (founded 2012), including work on gas power plant projects such as a contract with Sener Bonatti CCPP GmbH.
thesis.competitive_position: Project-based power-sector installation contractor with revenue that grew 56.3% to PLN 132.4M in 2023, but lumpy, contract-dependent earnings and no durable moat ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/); [StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/company)). A 2026 filing refers to an amendment of its contract with Sener Bonatti CCPP GmbH ([Financial filings summary via StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/)). Voting structure: 14.8M votes against about 11.0M shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/JWWINVEST/akcjonariat)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Voting preference: 14,800,000 votes at the AGM versus about 11.0M shares, so some holders control more votes than capital ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/JWWINVEST/akcjonariat)). Lumpy revenue and counterparty/contract-amendment risk on large power-plant EPC-type contracts ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/JWW/)). Prior ESPI notices on changes to rights attached to securities ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26644961-jww-invest-s-a-informacja-o-zmianie-praw-z-papierow-wartosciowych-emitenta)). Shareholder structure could not be verified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

name: WODKAN Przedsiebiorstwo Wodociagów i Kanalizacji S.A.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based financial-information group (founded 2000 by Przemyslaw Szalbierz and Grzegorz Raupuk) running the Analizy.pl fund-analysis and rating platform, financial conferences, and the KupFundusz fund-distribution subsidiary, serving the Polish investment-fund market.
thesis.competitive_position: Specialised provider of investment-fund data, ratings and events with a recognised niche brand in Poland, but small and tied to the fund-industry cycle ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/AOL/company)). Group revenue was PLN 12.9M in 2024 (+PLN 1.5M), with the conferences segment up 26.8% ([2024 consolidated annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51287969/DOC.20250407.51287969.Skonsolidowany_raport_roczny_2024_New_Connect_final-0.pdf)). Management letter says 2025 consolidated net profit again exceeded PLN 2.3M ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/145864,list-do-akcjonariuszy-grupy-analizy-online-2025)); Q1 2025 revenue fell 8.6% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/diversified-financials/wse-aol/analizy-online-shares/news/analizy-online-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings/amp)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Grzegorz Raupuk 236,811 shares (19.34%) as of 2026-01-31; 'others' 27.22% shown on the same page; total 1,224,082 shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat); [Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229601-analizy-online)). Earlier ESPI notices recorded reductions of holdings below 25% (Apr 2021) and below 20% (Feb 2022) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art35751941-analizy-online-s-a-zmniejszenie-stanu-posiadania-akcji-analizy-online-s-a-ponizej-20-00)). The rest of the register was not retrieved.
thesis.red_flags: Founder-led, tiny share base (1.22M shares) with thin liquidity on NewConnect ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/229601-analizy-online)). Revenue is tied to Polish fund-industry sentiment and event demand; Q1 2025 profit fell 40% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/diversified-financials/wse-aol/analizy-online-shares/news/analizy-online-reports-first-quarter-2025-earnings/amp)). Founder stake has been sold down from 46.4% (2010) to 19.34% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat)). No going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Grzegorz Raupuk (co-founder and management board member) 19.34% as of 31 Jan 2026 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ANALIZY/akcjonariat)); co-founder Przemyslaw Szalbierz and CEO Michal Duniec sit on the management board (holdings not retrieved) ([2024 annual report](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/51287969/DOC.20250407.51287969.Skonsolidowany_raport_roczny_2024_New_Connect_final-0.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Sofia-based Bulgarian manufacturer and seller of hygiene and cosmetic products in Bulgaria and abroad; controlled by Harisson Management Limited (Malta), which launched a squeeze-out of the remaining minority in 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Long-established Bulgarian household/cosmetics brand with a domestic niche but no evident global moat; competes against multinational FMCG groups ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/household/bul-arom/aroma-ad-shares/information)). Share capital was tripled earlier from BGN 5.16M to BGN 15.5M ([FFBH](https://www.ffbham.bg/en/post/aroma-to-triple-capital-to-bgn-15-5m-158997868995877)). With the controlling holder already above 95%, trading liquidity is minimal and the investment case now rests on squeeze-out terms.
thesis.main_shareholders: Harisson Management Limited (Malta) directly holds 8,056,189 shares; together with related parties and persons acting in concert it holds 14,940,038 shares = 96.438% of capital and 96.955% of votes, per the squeeze-out offer document registered with the Bulgarian FSC on 27 March 2026 ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Pending squeeze-out: the offer covers 551,791 shares at EUR 0.95 per share ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)); FSC Decision 238-TP of 14 Apr 2026 found gaps and inconsistencies that had to be corrected, including whether the minimum-price rule applies ([FSC](https://www.fsc.bg/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/238.pdf)). Delisting risk once the squeeze-out completes (sister company Aroma Real Estate was delisted in Jan 2020 after a Harisson squeeze-out ([SeeNews](https://seenews.com/news/aroma-real-estate-delists-from-bulgarian-stock-exchange-684315))). Controlling-holder dynamics with free float of about 3.6% of capital. An earlier Profit.bg item reported trading suspended during a dispute between former and current shareholders ([Profit.bg](https://www.profit.bg/article/2024012320274771640)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlled by Harisson Management Limited and related parties (96.438% of capital, 96.955% of votes); individual management holdings not disclosed (Simply Wall St shows insiders about 0.008%, undated) ([BSE Sofia offer document](https://download.bse-sofia.bg/prospekt/AROM-/Squeeze-out202605/1_Aroma_Squeeze-out-Part%20I-final.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Polish restaurant group (Mex Polska S.A.) operating and franchising casual-dining and street-food concepts including The Mexican, Prosty Temat, PanKejk, Pizzanova, Spoko Taco and Pijalnia Wodki i Piwa, in Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Polish restaurant operator with a portfolio of own brands, growing by opening at least six new venues a year (seven opened Jan-Sep 2025) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/spolki/mex-poland-wyniki-2025-q3), [Wiadomosci Handlowe](https://www.wiadomoscihandlowe.pl/franczyza-w-handlu/franczyza-gastronomiczna/przychody-mex-polska-urosly-o-15-proc-rdr-grupa-nie-dala-sie-wplywowi-kiepskiej-pogody-2528667)). Preliminary 2025 consolidated revenue was PLN 127.29M, +19.05% y/y, a record ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260112/mex-polska-szacuje-ze-w-25-skonsolidowane-przychody-wzrosly-rdr-o-1905-proc-do)). Brand ownership gives some differentiation but restaurants carry no durable moat; dividend policy now at least 30% of net profit, with the board recommending 50% of 2025 net profit ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/147655,zarzad-mex-polska-rekomenduje-przeznaczenie-na-dywidende-50-zysku-netto-za-2025-r)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Management-linked family foundations MEX Fundacja Rodzinna and OSTOJA Fundacja Rodzinna (Pawel Kowalewski, CEO, is president of OSTOJA); they sold 763,300 shares at PLN 3.60 in a Feb 2026 ABB; exact current % not retrieved ([Inwestycje.pl](https://inwestycje.pl/gielda/dwoch-akcjonariuszy-mex-polska-sprzedalo-w-abb-763-300-akcji-spolki-po-36-zl-szt/)). Familiar S.A. SICAV-SIF, formerly a significant holder, agreed on 22 Dec 2025 to sell all its shares ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/142407,koniec-impasu-w-akcjonariacie-mex-polska-familiar-s-a-sicav-sif-sprzeda-wszystkie-akcje)); 763,300 shares were bought at PLN 4.50 by two shareholders ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260218/akcjonariusze-mex-polska-zakupili-lacznie-763300-akcji-spolki-w-cenie-45-zl-za)).
thesis.red_flags: Governance: a long-running shareholder dispute with Familiar S.A. SICAV-SIF, including lawsuits against the company and related entities that the Dec 2025 settlement made conditional on withdrawal ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/142407,koniec-impasu-w-akcjonariacie-mex-polska-familiar-s-a-sicav-sif-sprzeda-wszystkie-akcje)). Controlling-holder dynamics: management-linked foundations hold a large block; free float being increased only recently. Restaurant sector exposure to wage, rent and food-cost inflation (not quantified in sources found). Small equity base (USD 4.1M per input).
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Pawel Kowalewski is president of OSTOJA Fundacja Rodzinna, a holder; he and Andrzej Domzal reportedly each bought 381,650 shares at PLN 4.50 (Feb 2026) ([Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260218/akcjonariusze-mex-polska-zakupili-lacznie-763300-akcji-spolki-w-cenie-45-zl-za)).

thesis.business_description: UK strategic communications group providing corporate events, brand experiences and film production, with North America cited by management as its largest growth opportunity; revenue GBP 29.5M for the 18 months to 31 Dec 2025.
thesis.competitive_position: Small events/communications agency with revenue up 7% to GBP 29.5M and underlying pre-tax profit GBP 797k (vs GBP 387k) over the 18 months to Dec 2025 ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-strong-18-months), [LSE](https://www.lse.co.uk/news/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-in-strong-18-months-umpy52bclk7kt7n.html)). Project-based, relationship-driven business with low switching costs; no structural moat evident. Cash GBP 2.2M at 31 Dec 2025 and GBP 4.1M at announcement ([Stockopedia](https://www-proxy.stockopedia.com/share-prices/aeorema-communications-LON:AEO/news/reg-aeorema-comms-plc-final-results-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20260518:nRSR6139Ea/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Highly concentrated register: top-25 holders own about 94% and individual insiders about 60.8% per Simply Wall St (illiquid AIM stock) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/media/aim-aeo/aeorema-communications-shares/ownership)). Project-based revenue with a change of year-end (18-month period) makes year-on-year comparison harder; dividend cut to 4p total vs 6p the prior year ([AJ Bell](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/aeorema-reports-revenue-underlying-profit-rise-strong-18-months)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders about 60.8% in aggregate (named insiders not retrieved) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/media/aim-aeo/aeorema-communications-shares/ownership)).

thesis.business_description: Formerly Triceps.pl; producer and distributor of dietary supplements, sports nutrition and healthy food in Poland and abroad, sold through own stores in several European countries and online (7-nutrition.com).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche sports-nutrition and supplements brand competing with larger Polish and international supplement makers, with no evident moat beyond brand and its own retail/online channels ([StockAnalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/7FT/company)). Q2 2025 revenue was PLN 8.68M (+33.9% y/y); trailing-12-month revenue PLN 27.6M and net profit PLN 1.13M as of mid-2025 ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/7FT/)). A dividend of PLN 0.31 per share from 2025 profit was approved in mid-2026 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/wiadomosci)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bankier table dated 28 Feb 2025: Michal Wasilewski 914,175 shares (51.00% of capital, 65.49% of votes); Arkadiusz Bala 350,040 shares (19.52% capital, 13.75% votes); Sone sp. z o.o. with SO International Ltd 9.82% capital / 6.91% votes; Michal Kopiczynski 7.75% / 5.46% ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat)). Share capital was cut to 1,545,415 shares after redemption of series A shares approved 3 Dec 2024, so current percentages may differ.
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder Wasilewski has about 51% of capital but about 65% of votes through voting-preference shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat)). Very small share base (about 1.5-1.8M shares) and equity, so thin liquidity. Series A share redemption in Dec 2024 changed the share base. Management board mandates were due to expire 30 June 2026 ([Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173472-7fit-sa-raport-za-iii-kwartal-2025.pdf)). No going-concern wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: Michal Wasilewski (management board member) 51.00% of capital and 65.49% of votes; CEO Arkadiusz Bala 19.52% of capital / 13.75% of votes, per Bankier table of 28 Feb 2025 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/7FIT/akcjonariat); [Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173472-7fit-sa-raport-za-iii-kwartal-2025.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Suntech S.A. (Warsaw, Poland; founded 1996) is a software house delivering agile software solutions for telecommunications, banking, energy and transport clients in Poland and abroad.
thesis.competitive_position: Small B2B software developer with long-standing telecom/banking clients, but project-based revenue and no evident moat. FY2025 revenue was about PLN 36.3m (-19%) and net profit PLN 0.62m (-80%), with Q2 and Q3 2025 revenue down 29% and 28% y/y ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-sun/suntech-shares/past); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/SUN/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Piotr Saczuk and Wojciech Franczak are listed on the company's investor page; share capital is 15,940,000 shares with 20,940,000 votes (privileged shares) ([Suntech investors](https://suntech.pl/en/investors/shareholders)); an older Bankier table (Nov 2020) showed large holders at 57.85% of shares and 68.26% of votes ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/SUNTECH/akcjonariat)); current percentages not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Sharp revenue and profit decline in 2025; privileged voting shares give founders control (20.94m votes vs 15.94m shares); small free float on NewConnect.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/management Piotr Saczuk and Wojciech Franczak listed as shareholders; exact percentages not verified ([Suntech investors](https://suntech.pl/en/investors/shareholders)).

thesis.business_description: Polish investment company (Grempco S.A., registered office Lozienica near Goleniow) managing a portfolio of capital investments in high-tech companies in construction engineering: GRYFITLAB Sp. z o.o. (R&D lab) and FLUID DESK Sp. z o.o. (CAD/BIM software for installation design).
thesis.competitive_position: Essentially a holding whose value is driven by FLUID DESK, a CAD/BIM engineering software niche; in May 2025 FLUID DESK signed an exclusive distribution agreement for its BIM platform in mainland China ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plgrmpc00016,o_firmie.html)). Tiny operation (3 employees per Bankier) with 24,612,300 shares; Bankier shows 2025 net revenue of PLN 263k and net profit of PLN 2,543k (unverified, likely valuation gains rather than operating income) ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/GREMPCO/wyniki-finansowe/jednostkowy/roczny)). No moat at the holding level.
thesis.main_shareholders: Katarzyna Monika Nikodemska: 19,810,000 shares = 80.49% of shares and 81.10% of votes (only holder above 5%) per the Q3 2025 interim report ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder owns ~80.5%, leaving ~19.5% free float and very thin liquidity ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)). Single-member management board (Dorota Sumislawska is also reported to chair the supervisory board in a 2023 report), a governance concentration. Value depends on unlisted subsidiaries; earnings can be mark-to-market gains rather than cash.
thesis.insider_ownership: Katarzyna Monika Nikodemska holds 80.49% (controlling shareholder; relation to management not established in sources) ([Grempco Q3 2025 report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/173334-grempco-iiiq2025.pdf)).

thesis.business_description: Chorzow-based Polish financial services firm offering factoring (disclosed and reverse), loans, receivables purchase and debt collection, aimed mainly at SMEs.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche factoring/receivables-finance provider in Poland with no clear moat; it competes with bank factoring units and larger specialists ([Stockanalysis company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/INS/company)). It has made venture-type co-investments (e.g. ADVISERO with LT Capital) ([Parkiet ESPI](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27600341-indos-s-a-wspolna-inwestycja-indos-sa-oraz-lt-capital-w-spolke-advisero)). Aggregator data show 2025 revenue of about 22.1M (PLN), unverified against the company statements ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/INS/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: VAKaT Fundacja Rodzinna 2,224,166 shares (31.20% of capital, 19.21% of votes); Ireneusz Glensczyk together with RIVA Fundacja Rodzinna w organizacji 62.47% of shares and 76.89% of votes (table undated, latest entry 2025-06-03) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos); [Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/INDOS/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling-holder dynamics: Glensczyk/RIVA group holds about 62% of shares but about 77% of votes (voting preference), and a family foundation (VAKaT) is also a large holder ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos)). Exchange notices show a 'correction of prior-year results' dated 2025-07-21, content not retrieved ([Bankier ESPI list via search](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/INDOS/wyniki-finansowe)). Leverage-funded factoring business; Q1 2025 net profit fell to about PLN 62k from about PLN 548k ([Q1 2025 report](https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/ebi/2025-05/0000168222_202505150000159105.pdf)). No going-concern or auditor qualification found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Chair/founder-linked group (Ireneusz Glensczyk with RIVA Fundacja Rodzinna w organizacji) holds 62.47% of shares and 76.89% of votes per undated Parkiet table ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/234961-indos)); exact roles of each named holder not confirmed.

thesis.business_description: French (Malakoff) designer, producer and distributor of wood-heating products under the EO2 and PIKS brands, including wood pellets, densified logs and bulk pellets; about 76 employees.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche French wood-pellet and biomass heating distributor with a regional brand and distribution footprint, but exposed to winter weather and pellet price swings; no clear moat ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/epa/ALEO2/company)). FY2025-26 revenue reached EUR 35.6M (vs 30.2M, +18%) with positive EBITDA of EUR 2.2M, but a net group loss of EUR 1.3M versus EUR 93k loss a year earlier ([Boursorama/Actusnews, 2 Jul 2026](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/eo2-resultats-annuels-2025-2026-7f4a56862c20e9d6e8fbc2263fb5ce80)). Management wants to reduce weather exposure by growing energy services.
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: Net loss widened to EUR 1.3M despite 18% revenue growth, and results depend on weather ([Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites-amp/eo2-resultats-annuels-2025-2026-7f4a56862c20e9d6e8fbc2263fb5ce80)). Market cap only about EUR 6.5M with about 2.1M shares on Euronext Growth, implying thin liquidity ([Extraetf](https://extraetf.com/ch/stock-profile/FR0010465534)). Shareholder structure could not be verified, so concentration or controlling-holder risk is unknown.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Astileu (Bihor county, Romania) manufacturer of building materials - lime, red brick and roof tile, and classified under refractory products manufacturing (CAEN 2320) - listed on the BVB AeRO market; 1,447,266 shares outstanding.
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional Romanian building-materials/refractory producer with about 61-73 employees (sources differ) ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA), [Economedia](https://economedia.ro/?p=218858)). Local production and site resources are the only visible advantage; no evidence of a durable moat. Declining 2025 turnover (about -5.8%) per aggregators ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA)).
thesis.main_shareholders: DNTL Project SRL (Cluj-Napoca) about 79.4% ([Economedia](https://economedia.ro/?p=218858)); Paval Holding reported just under 6% ([ZF](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/surpriza-fratii-paval-dedeman-fac-investitie-bursa-valori-bucuresti-22541173)); dates of both disclosures not confirmed.
thesis.red_flags: Controlled by DNTL Project SRL (about 79.4%), leaving a very small free float and weak liquidity on the AeRO market; the controlling holder's dynamics vs minorities are unverified. 2025 turnover fell about 5.8% ([Termene.ro](https://termene.ro/firma/98716-HELIOS-SA)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: Bigben Interactive S.A. (France) is the parent of Nacon (video-game publishing and gaming accessories) and also sells mobile, audio and gaming accessories, holding 56.72% of Nacon's capital and 68.74% of its voting rights at 31 August 2026.
thesis.competitive_position: Historically a European consumer-accessories and gaming group, but its value is now largely tied to Nacon, which has itself been in judicial reorganisation since 2 March 2026, and Bigben's own restructuring depends on adoption of Nacon's plan ([Fortuneo - Nacon update](https://bourse.fortuneo.fr/actualites/nacon-fait-le-point-sur-la-procedure-de-redressement-judiciaire-1258243); [Option Finance](https://www.optionfinance.fr/info-financiere-en-continu/d/2026-09-22-bigben-avance-dans-sa-restructuration-financiere.html)). No durable moat is evident under distress; press reports EUR 395m of losses ([TradingSat](https://www.tradingsat.com/bigben-interactive-FR0000074072/actualites/bigben-interactive-395-millions-d-euros-de-pertes-et-des-actionnaires-bientot-ecrases-le-geant-francais-des-accessoires-de-jeu-video-bigben-joue-sa-survie-1171977.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Nord Sumatra Investissements (Bolloré-controlled) about 21.72% and Alain Falc about 14.06%, free float about 64%, per an undated AbcBourse profile ([AbcBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/analyses/chiffres/BIGp)); these stakes are expected to be heavily diluted by the restructuring.
thesis.red_flags: Accelerated safeguard procedure (procédure de sauvegarde accélérée) opened 17 Aug 2026, extended to 17 Dec with a plan hearing on 9 Dec ([Fortuneo](https://bourse.fortuneo.fr/actualites/nacon-fait-le-point-sur-la-procedure-de-redressement-judiciaire-1258243)); debt-to-equity conversion and fresh-money capital increase (EUR 31m at Nacon, Bigben contributing EUR 16m and converting about EUR 19.5m of intragroup claims) mean massive dilution for existing shareholders ([Option Finance](https://www.optionfinance.fr/info-financiere-en-continu/d/2026-09-22-nacon-detaille-un-projet-entrainant-une-dilution-massive.html)); equity figure in the input (USD 366m) is likely stale given reported losses; Nacon suspended trading and filed for insolvency in Feb-Mar 2026 ([ABC Bourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/forums/msg1095193_nacon-fait-suspendre-la-cotation-de-ses-actions)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Alain Falc about 14.06% (undated AbcBourse profile) ([AbcBourse](https://www.abcbourse.com/analyses/chiffres/BIGp)); Maxime Falc not verified.

name: Casa de Bucovina - Club de Munte S.A.

thesis.business_description: Greek listed Venture Capital Company (E.K.E.S.) regulated as an Alternative Investment Fund manager under Law 4209/2013; its purpose under Law 2367/1995 is to take stakes in other companies. Founded 2014, listed on the Athens main market on 31 July 2018.
thesis.competitive_position: Tiny listed venture-capital vehicle (about 735k shares, market cap roughly EUR 5M); the first use of the VC-company structure on the Athens exchange, with returns depending on underlying portfolio holdings rather than a moat ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419); [Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/cnl-capital-ekes-aifm-ATH:CNLCAP)). It pays regular distributions, including EUR 0.15 per share and a remaining 2025 dividend of EUR 110,128.50 ([Powergame](https://www.powergame.gr/epichirisis/1360850/cnl-capital-dianomi-ypoloipou-merismatos-chrisis-2025-ypsous-110-12850-evro/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Holders of 5% or more of voting rights per the Athens exchange issuer page (undated): Michail Stasinopoulos 12.75%; CNL AEDOEE 6.67%; CNL Capital E.K.E.S. - AIFM itself 6.30% (own shares); Orasis Fund SPC 6.13% ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)).
thesis.red_flags: Very small free-float company with only about 735k shares and thin liquidity ([Stockopedia](https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/cnl-capital-ekes-aifm-ATH:CNLCAP)). Related-party structure: manager entity CNL AEDOEE is itself a 6.67% shareholder, and the company holds 6.30% of its own shares ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)). Portfolio valuation (unlisted holdings) is judgement-based; no going-concern or auditor-qualification wording found in search results.
thesis.insider_ownership: CNL AEDOEE (affiliated manager) 6.67% and Michail Stasinopoulos 12.75% per Athex issuer page; whether Stasinopoulos is a director not confirmed ([Athex issuer page](https://www.athexgroup.gr/en/market-data/issuers/1419)).

thesis.business_description: Polish debt-collection and receivables-management group (Kancelaria Prawna - Inkaso WEC S.A. with the WEC capital group) serving corporate creditors, with additional micro-factoring/receivables purchase activity; operates in Poland and is listed on NewConnect (ticker KPI/KANCELWEC).
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche player in the fragmented Polish debt-collection market, competing with much larger listed collectors (e.g. KRUK, Kredyt Inkaso); no evident moat beyond client relationships and legal-services know-how. Revenue was reported at roughly PLN 16.3M for 2025 (+15%) by a data aggregator ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/KPI/revenue/)), and management has pointed to micro-factoring as a growth line ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/wiadomosci/artykul/kancelaria-prawna---inkaso-wec-liczy-na,233,0,2125289.html)). Share capital is PLN 988,200 in 0.10 PLN shares, i.e. about 9.88M shares ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KANCELWEC/akcjonariat)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in public filings
thesis.red_flags: NewConnect (alternative market) listing with very small float and thin liquidity; Bankier's ownership table shows only about 7.25% of capital as 'Pozostali' (others) i.e. the holding is highly concentrated in a few holders ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/KANCELWEC/akcjonariat)). Company ran a buyback tender in 2025/2026 (250,000 shares at PLN 4.00 per Biznesradar, with 8.84M shares tendered, implying heavy oversubscription and low liquidity) ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/155320,inkaso-wec-sa-8-2026-podsumowanie-skupu-akcji-wlasnych)). Aug-2025 threshold-crossing notification filed (holder not identified) ([money.pl](https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/plkpwec00015,emitent,1.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed

thesis.business_description: MPL Verbum S.A. (Poznań, Poland) designs and runs loyalty and motivational programmes for businesses (products such as Sales Booster, Level Up, Cashback, Lead.me, Loyalty 3.0), mainly in Poland; fiscal year ends in April.
thesis.competitive_position: Small niche B2B loyalty/incentive programme provider with long client relationships (CEO Marcin Katański has led it since 2003) but no strong moat. FY2024/25 revenue was about PLN 37.5m (+19%) with net income of about PLN 1.07m; a PLN 0.21/share dividend was approved ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-ver/mpl-verbum-shares/news/mpl-verbum-full-year-2025-earnings-eps-z044-vs-z040-in-fy-20/amp); [Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/VER/revenue/); [Parkiet AGM notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43125931-mpl-verbum-spolka-akcyjna-zwolanie-zwyczajnego-walnego-zgromadzenia-akcjonariuszy-mpl-verbum-s-a-na-dzien-30-pazdziernika-2025r)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Marcin Katański 1,131,550 shares = 46.29%; Tadeusz Zieliński 783,000 shares = 32.03% (last change dated 2021-03-17; about 78.3% combined) ([Bankier shareholders](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MPLVERBUM/akcjonariat)).
thesis.red_flags: Two holders control about 78% (free float about 22%) and the register data is dated 2021, so current stakes are unverified; thin NewConnect liquidity; project-based, client-concentrated revenue (not quantified).
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Marcin Katański 46.29% of shares (about 50% of votes) per Bankier, dated 2021 ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/MPLVERBUM/akcjonariat)).

thesis.business_description: Jarocin (Poland) manufacturer of bituminous roofing/insulation membranes, being integrated into the Selena group after a 2025 takeover.
thesis.competitive_position: Polish producer of bituminous membranes; acquirer Selena FM (building chemicals group) bought it together with PHP TES, consolidating bituminous-membrane production ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/the-office-of-competition-and-consumer-protection-uokik-paved-the-way-for-the-selena-group-to-acquire-izolacja-jarocin-and-php-tes/)). Competitive position now depends on the parent; UOKiK cleared the concentration on 27 Aug 2025 ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/the-office-of-competition-and-consumer-protection-uokik-paved-the-way-for-the-selena-group-to-acquire-izolacja-jarocin-and-php-tes/)). Standalone moat limited.
thesis.main_shareholders: Selena Industrial Technologies sp. z o.o. (Selena FM group) 2,197,734 shares = 57.83% of capital and votes (of 3,800,000) per Parkiet shareholder table (undated) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/235521-izolacja-jarocin)). Former main holders Tomasz Ignatowicz, Zofia Pietrus and Anna Inczewska agreed in June 2025 to sell their stake (51.03%) at PLN 3.50/share ([Selena](https://selena.com/en/announcement-by-the-management-board-of-the-selena-group-on-the-conclusion-of-an-agreement-to-acquire-by-way-of-a-tender-offer-the-shares-of-izolacja-jarocin-s-a-and-the-shares-in-php-tes-sp-z-o/)).
thesis.red_flags: New controlling holder (57.83%) has suggested possible withdrawal of the shares from regulated-market trading ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art44197981-zmiany-w-izolacji-jarocin)); a May 2026 third-party profile flags very poor trading liquidity ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IZO/)). Delisting/squeeze-out risk, though none formally announced in sources found.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/former insiders (Ignatowicz, Pietrus, Inczewska) sold out in Sep 2025 (Pietrus sold 398,240 shares = 10.48%, per [Strefa Inwestorow](https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20250911/grupa-selena-rozliczenie-zlecenia-kupna-akcji-izolacja-jarocin-sa)); current management holdings not disclosed.

thesis.business_description: Krakow-based IT company offering EDI integration, web EDI, e-invoicing and eCMR solutions for data exchange between businesses, operating mainly in Poland as the Polish arm of the Vienna-based EDITEL group.
thesis.competitive_position: Niche B2B data-exchange/e-invoicing provider; it is a member of the PEF Expert consortium, which provides services through the broker of Poland's Electronic Invoicing Platform ([EMIS/aggregated profile summary](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/PL/EDITEL_SA_en_2010696.html)). Moat comes from integration with a group network and customer switching costs, but it is a very small company (about 24-26 employees per third-party data) ([StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EDL/company)). Management describes 2025 as a return to growth after a 2024 slowdown ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: EDITEL Austria GmbH 90.20% (2,662,333 of 2,951,567 shares and votes) as of 31 Dec 2025; other shareholders 9.80% ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)). Older Parkiet register shows IDE sp. z o.o. 2.98% (2012, likely stale) ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/232691-editel-polska)).
thesis.red_flags: Controlling parent holds 90.20% of shares and votes, leaving about 9.8% free float (liquidity and minority-holder risk; the parent already took a majority stake of 89.43% on 19 June 2019) ([2025 annual report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260527_121911_0000002949_0000075786.pdf)). Third-party sources disagree on whether the shares trade on NewConnect or the main GPW market.
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling holder is the parent EDITEL Austria GmbH (90.20%); individual management holdings not disclosed in sources found.

thesis.business_description: Ekopol Górnośląski Holding S.A. (Piekary Śląskie, Poland) is a holding focused on fuel distribution (diesel, petrol) and liquid-fuel tank sales, with steel products and fuel-management technology, and since October 2025 a residential development subsidiary (Ekopol Górnośląski Domy).
thesis.competitive_position: Regional fuel distributor with low-margin, commodity-type trading and little visible moat; diversification into housing development is new and unproven ([Ekopol 2025 directors' report](https://bonnier.pl/static/att/ebi/2026-05/20260528_090742_0000002984_0000076665.pdf)). Aggregator data show 2025 revenue of about PLN 230.6m (+11.3%), not verified against the audited statements ([Stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/EGH/revenue/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Andrzej Piecuch is shown at about 23.5% by a data vendor ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ko/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-egh/ekopol-gornoslaski-holding-shares/management)); the company has 2,513,525 shares of which 1,207,900 are privileged ([Biznesradar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/EKOPOL,3)); full >5% list is in the FY2025 report and was not verified.
thesis.red_flags: Privileged shares (1,207,900 of 2,513,525) give outsized voting control to insiders; fuel-trading margins are thin and exposed to price/regulatory swings; new real-estate development line adds execution risk; very small NewConnect free float and liquidity.
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Andrzej Piecuch about 23.5% (third-party data, unverified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/ko/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-egh/ekopol-gornoslaski-holding-shares/management)); supervisory board members and linked entities bought shares in Apr-Jul 2026 per exchange notices.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based technology company in sourcing and e-procurement, with a B2B purchasing platform for companies and public administration, listed on NewConnect; subsidiaries include IQmatica and Select8 (formerly Zingflow).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Polish e-procurement software vendor positioning on an 'AI-first' strategy ([TradingView](https://pl.tradingview.com/chart/LGT/vuKaCVVO/)); small scale (2024 revenue about 9.81M per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LGT/), about 17 employees). Moat is limited to platform/customer lock-in; no evidence found of dominant market share. Company describes itself as active in sourcing and e-procurement ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-lgt/logintrade-shares/information)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bankier shareholder table (holding dates 2013 and 2015, possibly stale): Marta Wudarzewska 25.41% of shares / 30.79% of votes; Michal Szlachcic 18.99% / 22.92%; Wlodzimierz Wudarzewski 18.85% / 22.83%; together 63.25% of shares and 76.54% of votes of 5,009,025 shares / 8,269,415 votes ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/LGTRADE/akcjonariat)). The company published an updated 5%+ list for the 30 June 2026 AGM, but its content could not be retrieved ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44746661-logintrade-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-glosow-na-zwyczajnym-walnym-zgromadzeniu-logintrade-s-a-w-dniu-30-czerwca-2026-r)).
thesis.red_flags: Voting power concentrated in three holders (about 76.5% of votes per Bankier, dated 2013-2015 data) via preferred voting shares (8.27M votes vs 5.01M shares), so minority holders have limited influence ([Bankier](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/LGTRADE/akcjonariat)). Small NewConnect issuer with limited liquidity; current holder percentages unverified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder family: Marta and Wlodzimierz Wudarzewski hold about 25.4% and 18.9% of shares per Bankier (dated 2013), and Tomasz Wudarzewski is CEO per [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/LGT/); Michal Szlachcic 18.99% (2015). Current figures unverified.

thesis.business_description: Sofia-based Bulgarian printing and outdoor advertising (billboard) company listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange, with 15 million shares in issue; FY2024 revenue about BGN 39.0M.
thesis.competitive_position: Established Bulgarian outdoor-advertising/printing operator; FY2024 revenue BGN 39.0M (+6.3%), net income BGN 1.53M (-16%); Q2 2025 revenue BGN 9.50M (-1.0%), net income BGN 722k ([Simply Wall St summaries via StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/BBRD/financials/)). Moat from owned/leased site inventory and permits in the domestic market; no evidence found of pricing power.
thesis.main_shareholders: Vassil Stefanov Genchev 25.024% and Stefan Vassilev Genchev 20.000% as of 31 Dec 2017 per company filing on Investor.bg ([Investor.bg](https://investor.bg/media/files/bulletin/p7s/06581d9d6f5e4c2a2e78a270740b0939.pdf.p7s)); no more recent breakdown found.
thesis.red_flags: Family-controlled (Genchev family about 45% as of 2017), with the chairman and CEO from the same family (Kalin Genchev, Stefan Genchev) - governance/related-party risk ([Stockanalysis company page](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/BBRD/company)). Thinly traded Bulgarian small cap; 2025 net sales reportedly fell about 4.5% per EMIS ([EMIS](https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/BG/Billboard_AD__Билборд_АД__en_2317696.html)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Genchev family: Vassil Stefanov Genchev 25.024% and Stefan Vassilev Genchev 20.000% (2017 filing, likely stale); Kalin Genchev is chairman and Stefan Genchev CEO.

thesis.business_description: Warsaw-based parcel-services provider (Pointpack S.A., NewConnect since Nov 2018) operating pick-up/drop-off (PUDO) points and automated parcel machines (APM); services were available at more than 18,600 points in Poland and 400+ in Croatia, with subsidiary P2A BOX (51%).
thesis.competitive_position: Niche logistics partner of Zabka convenience stores and carriers; 2025 revenue was PLN 85.7M (-32.6%) as the PUDO segment shrank after reduced cooperation with the Zabka network; APM revenue was PLN 56.3M (>66% of revenue) and Poczta Polska collected over 700 APMs ([Pointpack 2025 annual report](https://newconnect.pl/ebi/files/gpwdata/1747_20260323_212100_Raport-roczny-za-2025-PointPack-jednostkowy.pdf)). Q4 2025 revenue was about PLN 17.8M, -42% y/y ([Parkiet](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43724051-pointpack-pl-spolka-akcyjna-informacja-o-przewidywanej-sprzedazy-netto-w-iv-kw-2025-r)).
